Follow-up to #746. matchesProductionContract compared every contract field strictly, including zone, so a recovery VM created in us-west1-c (the only zone with n2-standard-2 capacity tonight) failed with 'Recovery-host verifier configuration is invalid; failing closed.' Zone now has to be in contract.allowedZones; every other field is still compared exactly. Adds a CLI test (us-west1-c reaches collection, us-west2-a fails closed). No egress policy, migration or prod-data changes.
